§6Drill§f attaches to the bottom of an AR rocket and auto-mines ores and regolith from the planet's surface as the rocket descends. It deposits items into an adjacent inventory or fluid duct.

Craft it shapeless: 1 Machine Structure + 1 Iron Pickaxe. The drill has a 3x3 mining area and mines at Diamond Pickaxe speed, but cannot harvest blocks above diamond harvest level.

§ePS:§f For asteroid mining, place the drill on the underside of the rocket frame's center column. Add at least one Oxygen Vent since most asteroids lack atmosphere and the drill exhaust will suffocate you without proper suit support.
